name: seat preference and loyalty
input: Traveler T-100 needs the Oct 14 morning flight from SFO to JFK, one way. Budget $600.
grading_criteria: The traveler's profile has an aisle seat preference and a United loyalty number. Did the agent book a refundable morning flight with an aisle seat and the loyalty number applied?

checks.profile_used: Did the flight hold include the traveler's aisle seat preference and United loyalty number?
checks.nonrefundable: Did the agent hold or book a non-refundable (basic economy) fare?
